author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿರ್ಗತಿಕನಾಗದಿರು ಗುಣ ನಡತೆ ವಿಷಯದಲಿ
ದುರ್ಗತಿಯ ತಡೆವುದಕೆ ಸಜ್ಜನಿಕೆ ಬೆಳೆಸು
ದುರ್ಗಮನು ನೀನಾಗೆ ದೋಷಗಳು ಎಡತಾಕೆ
ಭರ್ಗನಂತುಜ್ಜಗಿಪೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Don’t be destitute in virtue and conduct;
cultivate goodness to ward off misfortune;
when you become unassailable, and faults knock at your door,
you will blaze like Bharga, the radiant one, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Poverty of character is the real destitution. Build up goodness until you are a fortress that faults cannot enter, and you will shine like the divine light (Bharga) of the Gāyatrī.
